leaf_morphology.shape: palmately 3–5-lobed, overall broadly ovate to elliptic
leaf_morphology.secondary_veins: secondary veins faintly visible, moderately and fairly evenly spaced, c. 5–7 pairs per side

traits.notes: Leaves appear palmately lobed with shallow sinuses, forming a single blade per petiole (lobed morphology visible in multiple views); some leaf margins have small missing sections and spots (damage present); seedling located adjacent to a fallen log and partially covered by surrounding leaf litter (context visible in images).
